Access.name: loadPdfInstanceIdPraticaMOM
Access.Query: select PDF_INSTANCE_ID from PDF_INSTANCE where EXTERNAL_ENTITY_APPL = 'MOM' and EXTERNAL_ENTITY_NAME = 'PRATICA' and EXTERNAL_ENTITY_KEY = ? and CREATION_USERTYPE = 'SEDE'

Access.name: getClonedPdfInstanceId
Access.Query: select PDF_INSTANCE_ID from PDF_INSTANCE where ORIGINAL_PDF_INSTANCE_ID = ? and EXTERNAL_ENTITY_APPL = 'MOM' and EXTERNAL_ENTITY_NAME like 'DOPPIASPUNTA-MOM-%'
